en: Four players. 13 cards each. Call how many tricks you will win.
Follow the leading suit. Beat the highest card if you can.
No leading suit? Play a spade if you have one.
Meet your call: +bid, plus 0.1 per extra trick. Miss it: −bid.
You must play the led suit if you have it.
When following, you must play higher than the best card of that suit so far if you can, unless a spade has already trumped the trick.
If you're out of the led suit, you must play a spade that beats every spade already played.
If you can't follow, can't win with a spade, or have no spades, any card is legal.
